name: Noah Green
education: B.S. in Computer Engineering, University of Texas at Austin
summary: Senior site reliability engineer with 6 years of experience running Linux and Kubernetes at scale, defining SLOs, driving incident management, and building Prometheus and Grafana observability with Python automation.
strengths: Owns SLOs and error budgets for critical production services
Built Prometheus and Grafana dashboards and alerting used across the org
Leads incident management as on-call primary and post-incident reviews
Automates toil reduction with Python and Terraform on Kubernetes
gaps: Go usage is tooling-level, not full production service development
Limited Windows and legacy on-prem systems exposure - largely cloud-native Linux
resumeText: Noah Green is a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at Meridian Payroll where he owns availability for the payments platform. He defined the SLO framework, built Prometheus and Grafana observability, and drives incident management for on-call rotations. He has spent 6 years operating Linux and Kubernetes infrastructure, previously at Northgate Telco, automating away manual work with Python and Terraform.
